correctness.rationale: For n>1, internal reciprocal-closed endpoint-stripped S has sum n−1. Each selected shell n^j A_j consists solely of divisors of n^k in distinct strict intervals, so palindromic A_j=A_{k−1−j} ensures n^k/x remains in matching shell and sum is 1+n^k+(n−1)Σ_{j=0}^{k−1}n^j=2n^k. Distinct base choices reconstruct from shells: exact subfamily r(n)^ceil(k/2), not entire R(n^k). At n=45045 (48 divisors), exact DP and independently split MITM over all 23 proper reciprocal pairs each yield 695, giving exponent log695/(2log45045). Verification finite input exhaustive; infinite k uses injection proof.
residual_risks: The claimed contribution is a relatively direct counting extension of published Theorem 5; alternate expositions may have noted independent mirror shell choices.
Bound counts only explicitly constructed subfamily; it is not an exact formula for unrestricted R(n^k).
